NETWORK_ERROR.title: No Connection
NETWORK_ERROR.message: We couldn't reach the server. Please check your internet connection and try again.

OFFLINE.title: You're Offline
OFFLINE.message: Your device isn't connected to the internet. We'll resume as soon as the connection is back.

DB_UNAVAILABLE.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
DB_UNAVAILABLE.message: Our servers are taking a short break. We'll be back up in a moment. Please try again shortly.

401.title: Sign In Required
401.message: This page is only available to signed-in users. Please sign in to continue.

FORBIDDEN.title: Access Denied
FORBIDDEN.message: You don't have permission to access this page. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact support.

403.title: Access Denied
403.message: You don't have permission to access this page. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact support.

404.title: Page Not Found
404.message: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been moved. Check the URL or head back home.

408.title: Request Timed Out
408.message: The request took longer than expected. This is usually temporary — please try again in a moment.

429.title: Too Many Requests
429.message: You've hit the rate limit. Please wait a few seconds before trying again. If this persists, contact support.

500.title: Something Went Wrong
500.message: An unexpected error occurred on our end. Our team has been notified. Please try again in a moment.

502.title: Connection Hiccup
502.message: We couldn't reach one of our services. This is usually momentary — please try again.

503.title: Under Maintenance
503.message: We're applying a quick update to improve the experience. Please try again in a few minutes.

504.title: Server Took Too Long
504.message: A backend service didn't respond in time. We're looking into it — please try again shortly.

GENERIC.title: Something Went Wrong
GENERIC.message: We hit an unexpected issue. Our team has been notified. Please try again in a moment.
